w.text: Provides 44.1% CRIT DMG and, at R1, grants 10% ATK SPD and up to 48% Normal Attack DMG after using his Skill and landing Normal Attacks. An excellent 5-star alternative, just behind Cashflow Supervision.

w.name: The Widsith
w.text: Provides 55.1% CRIT DMG and, at R5, grants a random 10-second buff: 120% ATK, 96% Elemental DMG Bonus, or 480 EM. A strong 4-star option for Wriothesley, especially at high refinements, though its random passive makes performance inconsistent

w.name: Ballad of the Boundless Blue
w.text: Provides 30.6% Energy Recharge and, at R5, grants up to 48% Normal Attack DMG and 36% Charged Attack DMG after hitting enemies. A solid F2P option for Wriothesley, especially if he needs extra Energy Recharge.

w.name: Mappa Mare
w.text: Craftable Elemental Mastery choice; triggering Melt reliably procs its Elemental DMG Bonus.

a.text: Provides 18% ATK and boosts Stellar-Conduct DMG by 40%, with 16% CRIT Rate against affected enemies. Wriothesley’s best-in-slot set for Stellar-Conduct teams, though Marechaussee Hunter remains strong for his other playstyles.

Provides 15% Normal and Charged Attack DMG and up to 36% CRIT Rate when HP fluctuates. Wriothesley’s best-in-slot set for traditional Freeze and Melt teams, with excellent synergy from his HP mechanics.

Provides 15% Cryo DMG and up to 40% CRIT Rate against Cryo-affected or Frozen enemies. A strong option for Freeze teams, but Wriothesley’s Charged Attacks can Shatter enemies and reduce Freeze uptime. Marechaussee Hunter is generally more flexible

t.name: Conducted Chaos
t.text: Wriothesley leads on-field Stellar-Conduct damage, Mitya adds off-field Electro damage, Odette enables and buffs Stellar-Conduct, and Nicole provides shielding and teamwide ATK buffs.

t.name: Freeze Frame
t.text: Wriothesley leads on-field Cryo damage, Furina provides Hydro and a massive teamwide DMG Bonus, Shenhe boosts Cryo damage, and Escoffier heals while shredding Cryo/Hydro RES.

t.name: Fire Meets Frost
t.text: Wriothesley drives on-field Melt damage, Durin provides Pyro application, Nicole delivers teamwide ATK buffs, and Xilonen shreds Cryo/Pyro RES while boosting damage.

t.name: Frost on a Budget
t.text: Wriothesley drives Reverse Melt damage, Xiangling provides off-field Pyro, Sucrose shares EM and shreds Cryo RES, and Bennett supplies ATK buffs, healing, and Pyro energy.

w.name: Skyward Atlas
w.text: High Base ATK and ATK% scaling make Skyward Atlas an excellent DPS weapon for Heizou. Its Elemental DMG Bonus and additional passive damage complement his Anemo-focused playstyle.

w.name: A Thousand Floating Dreams
w.text: Provides massive Elemental Mastery and boosts reaction damage, making it a strong option for Heizou's EM-focused driver build and reaction-based teams.

w.name: The Widsith
w.text: Provides substantial CRIT DMG and powerful randomized buffs, making it an excellent 4-star choice for Heizou's Anemo DPS build.

w.name: Solar Pearl
w.text: Provides valuable CRIT Rate and boosts Normal Attack, Skill, and Burst damage, making it a strong option for Heizou's Anemo DPS build.

w.name: Mappa Mare
w.text: Refines give Elemental Mastery and boost elemental DMG after triggering a reaction.

w.name: Wandering Evenstar
w.text: Battle Pass option that boosts Skill, Burst, and Normal Attack DMG after hits.

a.text: Boosts Swirl damage and reduces enemies' resistance to the elements Swirled, making it Heizou's best overall set for reaction driving and team support.
Boosts Elemental Skill damage significantly, making it a strong alternative for Heizou's Skill-focused DPS build, especially in quickswap teams.

t.name: The Final Suspect
t.text: Faruzan amplifies Heizou's Anemo damage while Yelan provides powerful off-field damage and Bennett boosts ATK and provides healing. A strong hypercarry team built around maximizing Heizou's powerful Skill hits.

t.name: Anemo Authority
t.text: Xianyun enables powerful Plunging Attacks while boosting their damage, Furina provides off-field Hydro damage and a teamwide DMG bonus, and Bennett adds healing and ATK buffs. A strong plunge-focused Heizou DPS team.

t.name: Anemo-nomicon
t.text: Fischl and Ineffa provide consistent off-field Electro damage while Xingqiu adds Hydro application and defensive utility. Heizou drives powerful Electro-Charged reactions while keeping the team swirling.

t.name: CSI: Mondstadt
t.text: Xingqiu and Xiangling provide powerful off-field Hydro and Pyro damage while Bennett supplies healing and ATK buffs. Heizou drives constant reactions and Swirls, amplifying the team's damage with Viridescent Venerer.

why.v:
EM DPS: Viridescent Venerer, Skyward Atlas, EM/EM/EM (Substats prioritize EM and enough ER to burst comfortably)
Anemo Main DPS: Viridescent Venerer, A Thousand Floating Dreams, ATK%/Anemo DMG/CR (Substats: CR/CD > ATK% > ER > EM) Swirl DMG Does NOT scale with talent levels.

w.name: Staff of the Scarlet Sands
w.text: Provides massive CRIT Rate and converts Elemental Mastery into ATK, making it an exceptional choice for Rosaria's Reverse Melt build.

w.name: Staff of Homa
w.text: Provides substantial CRIT DMG and ATK, making it a powerful universal option for Rosaria's personal damage across multiple team types.

w.name: Wavebreaker's Fin
w.text: Provides high Base ATK, ATK%, and a powerful Elemental Burst DMG bonus, making it an excellent option for Burst-focused Rosaria builds, especially at high refinements.

w.name: "The Catch"
w.text: Provides Energy Recharge, Burst DMG, and Burst CRIT Rate, making it a strong free option for Rosaria's Burst-focused damage and support builds.

a.text: Provides Elemental Mastery and additional ATK or EM after triggering reactions, making it an excellent choice for Rosaria's Reverse Melt build.
a.stats: CRIT Rate > CRIT DMG > EM > ER > ATK%

a.text: Boosts Cryo DMG and provides significant CRIT Rate against Cryo-affected or Frozen enemies, making it her best set for Freeze teams.
a.stats: CRIT Rate > CRIT DMG > ATK% > ER

a.text: Boosts Elemental Burst damage and increases the entire team's ATK after using her Burst, making it her best support set for ATK-scaling teams.
a.stats: CRIT Rate > ER > CRIT DMG > ATK%

t.name: Melt & Mayhem
t.text: Rosaria and Citlali provide Cryo application for Mavuika's Melt reactions. Bennett adds healing, ATK buffs, and Pyro Resonance.

t.name: Cryo Queens
t.text: Rosaria provides additional Cryo damage and CRIT Rate sharing while Furina supplies Hydro application and damage buffs. Escoffier provides healing and Cryo/Hydro RES reduction.

t.name: Ghosts & Vapors
t.text: Xingqiu enables Vaporize while Rosaria adds Cryo application for occasional Melt reactions. Zhongli provides shielding and resistance reduction.

t.name: Budget Blizzard
t.text: Rosaria and Kaeya provide consistent Cryo damage and application while Xiangling triggers Reverse Melt. Bennett supplies healing, ATK buffs, and energy support.

why.v:
Freeze: Blizzard Strayer, Staff of Homa, ATK%/Cryo DMG/CD
Support: Noblesse Oblige, Favonius Lance, ATK%/Cryo DMG/CR. May also use Emblem of Severed Fates artifact set to meet ER needs.

w.name: Favonius Codex
w.text: ATK% substat feeds her heals, and the passive refunds 4 Energy every 2s plus party-wide HP regen.

w.name: Kagura's Verity
w.text: hits spawn 6 particles every 12s; her multi-hit Skill procs it often.

w.name: Prototype Amber
w.text: On swap, the next character gains 48% ATK for 10s — a cheap buff for the on-field DPS.

w.name: Flowing Purity
w.text: ATK% substat scales healing, and the passive adds Energy Recharge after casting the Skill.

w.name: Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers
w.text: substat plus an ATK-boosting passive; a free four-star that props up both heal output and Burst uptime.

a.text: 4pc grants the party +20% ATK for 12s after her Burst, which she casts every rotation anyway.
Her Skill damage triggers the 4pc for 20% party ATK and shield strength.
2pc Healing Bonus plus a bubble that converts overhealing into AoE Hydro damage.

t.name: Frozen Verdict
t.text: Charlotte provides teamwide healing and Freeze utility while Furina buffs the team's damage. Kazuha provides grouping and resistance reduction.

t.name: Frozen Assets
t.text: Charlotte adds additional healing and Cryo application while Furina buffs Skirk's damage. Escoffier provides Cryo/Hydro resistance reduction.

t.name: Shiver Me Timbers
t.text: Charlotte supplies healing and Cryo Resonance while Furina provides Hydro application and damage buffs. Kazuha groups enemies and shreds resistance.

t.name: Budget Blizzard
t.text: An accessible Freeze team with Kaeya as the on-field damage dealer. Xingqiu provides Hydro application, Sucrose offers grouping and buffs, and Charlotte keeps everyone healthy.
